Race:1 (176) NGAU CHI WAN HANDICAP (Sec1) Class 5 2200 m

Pla. Horse
No		 Colour Horse Dr. Jockey Incident
3 1 PALACE PAL (G172) 6 Z Purton Over the concluding stages raced tight between KINGLY DEMEANOR and GOLDEN FAIRY.
6 2 SUPER HONG KONG (D241) 1 H Bowman Jumped only fairly and then was crowded by NICE BIRDIE which shifted in after making contact with KINGLY DEMEANOR. After the event, H Bowman reported that he was unable to improve on the Home Turn when he was positioned behind NICE BIRDIE. He added however that after shifting to that runner’s inside on straightening SUPER HONG KONG did not respond to his riding and was somewhat disappointing. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
5 3 CHATEAU LE PECHE (H471) 8 M F Poon (-2) No report.
1 4 KINGLY DEMEANOR (H486) 3 M L Yeung Bumped at the start. Sent for sampling post-race.
7 5 NICE BIRDIE (G470) 2 C L Chau (-2) Bumped at the start. After the event, C L Chau reported that his mount was disadvantaged by the pace of the race being run inside of standard time throughout the early stages. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
2 6 FURY AND GOLD (H202) 9 A Atzeni Jumped only fairly and from the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages. In the middle stages raced keenly and near the 1500 Metres was steadied away from TIGER AND GOLD. When questioned, A Atzeni stated that his instructions were to hold a position behind midfield and to allow his mount to commence to improve into the event from the 600 Metres. He added that he was not privy to the instructions that were issued to Jockey Y L Chung and making the Home Turn he was able to improve to the inside of TIGER AND GOLD to obtain clear running. Trainer C H Yip confirmed the instructions issued to Jockey Atzeni. Sent for sampling post-race.
9 7 TIGER AND GOLD (J064) 4 Y L Chung (-3) Raced wide and without cover from the 800 Metres. When questioned regarding the tactics adopted, Y L Chung stated that his instructions were to attempt to hold a forward position with his mount stepping up in distance. He said he was also given the option to make a mid-race move if circumstances permitted as TIGER AND GOLD is one-paced. He said due to the early stages of the event being run inside of standard time, TIGER AND GOLD settled further back than instructed. He said although he was aware the early stages of the event were run inside of standard time, he was of the opinion that near the 800 Metres the pace had reduced and as a consequence he elected to make a forward move in accordance with the instructions issued. He said from the 600 Metres TIGER AND GOLD lay out and as a consequence made the Home Turn wider which allowed FURY AND GOLD to obtain clear running to his inside. Trainer C H Yip confirmed the instructions issued and expressed satisfaction with the manner in which TIGER AND GOLD was ridden.
4 8 GOLDEN FAIRY (E448) 5 C Y Ho Near the 50 Metres, when giving ground, was steadied when crowded between PALACE PAL which was taken out slightly by KINGLY DEMEANOR (M L Yeung) and FURY AND GOLD (A Atzeni) which shifted in. M L Yeung was advised to exercise more care and A Atzeni was reprimanded.
8 9 SPLENDID STAR (G026) 7 L Hewitson Stood flat-footed as the start was effected and lost ground. The barrier manners of SPLENDID STAR was considered unacceptable. Before being allowed to race again, SPLENDID STAR will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial.

Race:2 (177) LUNG CHEUNG HANDICAP (Sec2) Class 4 1650 m

Pla. Horse
No		 Colour Horse Dr. Jockey Incident
4 1 ESCAPE ROUTE (E273) 4 A Atzeni Shortly after the start raced tight between DURHAM STAR and D STAR which shifted in slightly. A Atzeni (ESCAPE ROUTE) pleaded guilty to a careless riding charge for causing interference near the 50 Metres (see D STAR).
3 2 VIVA CHALEUR (G368) 1 L Ferraris K C Leung (THE AZURE) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 1400 Metres he allowed his mount to shift in when insufficiently clear of LUCKY TOUCH, resulting in LUCKY TOUCH being taken in across the running of VIVA CHALEUR, causing VIVA CHALEUR to be checked to avoid the heels of LUCKY TOUCH. K C Leung was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Sunday, 1 December 2024 and to expire on Thursday, 5 December 2024 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays). In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 2 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered his good race riding record. Near the 300 Metres was hampered when taken in by SOLAR GOGO which hung in despite the efforts of its rider. Approaching the 200 Metres VIVA CHALEUR then became held up for clear running between SOLAR GOGO and THE AZURE and made contact with SOLAR GOGO on a number of occasions before obtaining clear running near the 200 Metres.
9 3 D STAR (G374) 5 B Avdulla Near the 1200 Metres became unbalanced when bumped by ESCAPE ROUTE which was taken out by DURHAM STAR (L Hewitson) when that runner shifted to the outside of VIVA CHALEUR. L Hewitson was severely reprimanded and advised he must ensure he is sufficiently clear when shifting ground. Near the 700 Metres was steadied when crowded by SOLAR GOGO (C L Chau) which lay in as its rider commenced a forward move. C L Chau was reprimanded and advised he would be expected to make a greater effort to prevent his mounts from shifting ground. Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event. A Atzeni (ESCAPE ROUTE) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 50 Metres he allowed his mount to shift in when not clear of DURHAM STAR, resulting in DURHAM STAR being taken in and crowding the running of D STAR which was checked when it lost its rightful running and also contributing to TRADITION being checked to avoid the heels of THE AZURE. A Atzeni was suspended from riding in races for one Hong Kong raceday to be conducted on Wednesday, 4 December 2024 at Happy Valley. In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 2 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered his excellent race riding record. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
1 4 LUCKY TOUCH (J203) 7 Z Purton Crowded near the 1400 Metres. Near the 250 Metres raced tight to the inside of THE AZURE which shifted in before being corrected by its rider. Sent for sampling post-race.
8 5 DURHAM STAR (E082) 3 L Hewitson Crowded over the concluding stages.
12 6 SUPER TREASURE (J211) 9 H T Mo (-2) No report.
11 7 SOLAR GOGO (H390) 10 C L Chau (-2) Hung in in the Home Straight and near the 200 Metres shifted in, made contact with VIVA CHALEUR and became unbalanced.
10 8 SUPER BEN (J148) 12 K De Melo From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
6 9 AMAZING AWARD (J236) 6 B Thompson Raced tight to the inside of D STAR for some distance near the 150 Metres. Raced tight over the concluding stages.
7 10 TRADITION (J111) 11 Y L Chung (-3) Over the concluding stages was steadied when crowded between THE AZURE and AMAZING AWARD. After the race, an endoscopic examination was conducted on TRADITION at the request of Trainer Y S Tsui. The Veterinary Surgeon said this examination showed a substantial amount of mucus in the horse’s trachea.
2 11 FIREFOOT (J183) 2 M L Yeung Sent for sampling post-race.
5 12 THE AZURE (J227) 8 K C Leung K C Leung pleaded guilty to a careless riding charge for causing interference near the 1400 Metres (see VIVA CHALEUR). In the early part of the Home Straight lay in before being corrected by its rider. After the event, K C Leung stated that whilst his instructions were to be more forward due to the expected lack of early speed, he did not anticipate leading the event. He said when THE AZURE jumped well, he was able to cross to the front. Trainer F C Lor confirmed the instructions issued.

Race:4 (179) HUNG LUEN HANDICAP (Sec1) Class 4 1000 m

Pla. Horse
No		 Colour Horse Dr. Jockey Incident
3 1 MA COMET (H391) 4 Z Purton When questioned regarding his riding in the early part of the Home Straight and the reason he did not apply full pressure to his mount until near the 200 Metres, Z Purton stated that at its last race start Trainer J Richards was of the opinion that the horse lacked concentration when it was in the lead soon after straightening. He said tonight he was issued with the instruction not to place his mount under full pressure too soon in an attempt to have MA COMET finish the race off in a strong manner. He said in accordance with those instructions he remained racing behind NOTTHESILLYONE until near the 200 Metres where he then placed his mount under full pressure. He further stated that, in his opinion, once MA COMET improved into the lead it once again lacked concentration and did not fully respond to his riding over the concluding stages. Trainer J Richards confirmed the instructions and expressed satisfaction with the manner in which Jockey Purton had ridden MA COMET. He added that he would now apply blinkers to MA COMET for its next race start to assist with its concentration over the concluding stages.
2 2 LEAN MASTER (H134) 1 E C W Wong (-7) Approaching the 300 Metres was steadied away from VICTORYTHIRTYTHREE. Sent for sampling post-race.

General

1.

Following the Hong Kong Observatory’s announcement of issuing Tropical Cyclone Warning Signal No. 8 at 11:10 pm, The Hong Kong Jockey Club determined that the running of the remaining Races 7, 8 and 9 at tonight’s Happy Valley race meeting be abandoned.

2.

Racing Laboratory tests of PAKISTAN FRIEND, CHATEAU LE PECHE, KINGLY DEMEANOR, GENEVA, PACKING ANGEL, CALIFORNIATOTALITY, JUMBO FORTUNE, SOARING BRONCO, LIEFLINE EXPRESS, SUGAR BALL, MARKWIN, DRAGON JOY, MASTER OF ALL, YUEN LONG ELITE, SOLID WIN, FLYING LUCK, MASSIVE SOVEREIGN, LA CITY BLANCHE, ENSUED, GLORY ELITE, LADY’S CHOICE, SKY TRUST, MY WISH, STEPS AHEAD, AEROINVINCIBLE, ARMOUR WAR EAGLE (3.11.24) and COSMO NAVIGATOR, VULCANUS, SPEEDSTAR, JOYFUL LIFE, GORGEOUS VITALITY, PODIUM, ISLAND GOLDEN, SPEEDY CHARIOT, SUPER EAGLE, GALVANIC, SURE JOYFUL, PRINCE ALEX, STORMING DRAGON, BEAUTY DESTINY, GIANT LEAP, YEE CHEONG SPIRIT, CHAIN OF GOLD, WINNING STEPS, BRAVE STAR, AURORA LADY, GOKO WIN, CHILL CHIBI, FLAMINGO TRILLION (6.11.24) proved negative.
